description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTerminationDao class, which provides database access methods for EmployeeTerminationRecord entities within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods to save, retrieve by ID, and list termination reasons.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationDao
classes.description: Data access object for handling employee termination records, providing methods to save, retrieve, and list termination reasons.

methods.name: saveEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeTerminationRecord entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeTermination
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeTerminationRecord by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Returns a list of all TerminationReason entities ordered by name.
